scope: One fixed 900-update fit on the same 46 training pairs. The intervention is the lead-weight vector inside the joint paired loss. The completed augmented endpoint is the matched reference. No data, model, optimizer, scale, seed or update-count change.
rationale: H1 makes early paired over-response visible to the existing unresolved-noise loss and absolute state loss. H24 gives direct supervision in the interval where the dual-axis and held-roll rollouts diverge. H32 retains half of the weight. This changes a single lead-weight vector shared by both terms of the existing paired loss.

evaluation.held_timing: Reuse the frozen validation_lateral tick 168 nominal and signed branches. Report absolute position, velocity and spin and Newton-resolved JVP/finite secants. Keep the H32 short-pulse JVP and secant passes, and require both metrics to pass for at least one of reversal or dual-axis. H32 nominal position error <=1.10 times the matched 46-pair reference.
evaluation.legacy_protection: Reuse all 22 legacy protections against the 40-pair reference and report the same checks against the 46-pair reference separately. Require all 22 against the 40-pair run before treating this candidate as a replacement. Report the held-roll sign at history_validation_yminus006_advance tick 72 by identity.
evaluation.diagnostic: Report per-lead signed position half differences and independent one-step versus free error at H1, H8, H16, H24 and H32, with the previously frozen floors. The single design does not identify which redistributed lead caused a change or establish policy performance.

stop_conditions: Frozen data, recipe, reference or anchor stream mismatch
Nonfinite losses or gradients, resource or wall-clock cap
Fixed 900-update endpoint and development scoring complete
No checkpoint selection, automatic rerun or added variants
